items.title: HCL Tech sees revenue rebound, but AI deflation remains a concern
items.description: HCL Technologies recorded a 2% increase in revenue during the September quarter, following two quarters of decline. The company secured new deals worth $3,258 million, indicating strong demand despite global uncertainties. While there is cautious optimism regarding AI's impact, the overall revenue guidance remained largely unchanged. AI-related revenue for HCLTech reached an annualized $876 million, accounting for a significant portion of total revenue.

items.title: Groww Q2 results preview: MOFSL sees 41% revenue growth; margins, derivatives business in focus
items.description: Billionbrains Garage Ventures is poised to unveil its Q2FY27 results, projecting impressive revenue growth compared to the previous year. Analysts from Motilal Oswal Financial Services anticipate revenues reaching Rs 1,434 crore. Additionally, the forecast for EBITDA reflects a significant year-on-year uplift, highlighting robust profitability. Nonetheless, concerns arise from margin pressures and a decline in derivatives revenue sequentially, making it vital to observe financial performance across various business segments.

items.title: Anand Rathi Share and Stock Brokers Q2 results: Profit jumps 50% YoY to Rs 42 crore, revenue rises 20%
items.description: Anand Rathi Share and Stock Brokers reported a 50% year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 41.93 crore in Q2FY27, while revenue from operations grew 20.25% to Rs 273.21 crore. Growth was supported by higher MTF interest income, distribution revenue and continued client acquisition amid market volatility.

items.title: Tata Elxsi Q2 Results: Profit rises 10% YoY to Rs 170 crore; revenue grows 15%
items.description: Tata Elxsi reported a 10% year-on-year rise in net profit to Rs 170 crore in Q2, while revenue from operations grew 15% to Rs 1,056 crore. Higher employee and operating expenses, along with lower other income, weighed on margins. Net profit for the first half of FY27 rose 14%.
